name: City of Irvine
disclaimer: Irvine has significant HOA coverage (many neighborhoods within the Irvine Company master plan). CC&Rs often impose standards beyond the municipal code. Verify with City of Irvine Planning and your HOA/CC&Rs.

notes: Most of Irvine is governed by planned community zoning (PC zone).
HOA/CC&Rs are prevalent and may restrict ADU appearance, materials, colors — these are private restrictions.
State law preempts CC&Rs that effectively prohibit ADUs, but architectural standards may still apply.
Verify with HOA architectural review committee BEFORE finalizing design.

citations.hoa_preemption: CA Civ Code §4751 — HOAs cannot prohibit ADUs

adu.hoa_note: CA Civil Code §4751 prohibits HOAs from banning ADUs, but they can impose reasonable design standards. Document CC&R restrictions and resolve before permit application.
